title: VQIL: Visible Quantum Interference Learning for Perturbation Response Ranking on Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.13689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning how local perturbations affect a network is important for identifying which components drive or absorb a system's response. We formulate this as seed-conditioned response ranking: given a perturbation at one seed node, ranking all other nodes by response strength. This is challenging when the model is given only the interaction topology, while the mechanism governing how perturbations propagate must be learned from data. We present VQIL (Visible Quantum Interference Learning), a trainable Szegedy quantum walk for seed-conditioned ranking. Edge weights, link phases, and per-node phase rotations are optimized end-to-end by backpropagation while the walk operator remains unitary throughout training. Node scores are obtained from a geometrically discounted coherent sum of quantum-walk amplitudes, enabling quantum interference before the final squared-norm readout. translated_title: VQIL：面向图上扰动响应排序的可见量子干涉学习
translated_abstract: 学习局部扰动如何影响网络，对于识别哪些组件驱动或吸收系统的响应至关重要。我们将该问题形式化为种子条件下的响应排序：给定在一个种子节点处施加的扰动，按响应强度对所有其他节点进行排序。当模型仅获得交互拓扑结构、而扰动传播的机制必须从数据中学习时，这一任务极具挑战性。我们提出了VQIL（可见量子干涉学习），一种用于种子条件下排序的可训练Szegedy量子游走方法。边权重、链路相位以及逐节点的相位旋转通过反向传播进行端到端优化，同时游走算符在整个训练过程中始终保持幺正性。节点得分由量子游走幅值的几何折扣相干和得到，从而在最终的平方范数读出之前实现量子干涉。由于每个学习到的参数都附加在具名的边或节点上，……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出VQIL，一种在整个训练过程中保持幺正性、可通过反向传播端到端训练的Szegedy量子游走模型，利用量子干涉机制学习扰动传播方式，实现图上给定种子节点的扰动响应强度排序。
